Because of this, the identity platform team requires a 10% canary rollout and a 14-day optional-mode period before enforcement. I have not yet updated the rollout ticket with this information.

IT Operations must exclude those accounts from enrollment until that time. I have not yet added the exception list to the rollout plan, and the exact plan change I require is adding a temporary account exclusion for those 18 contractor accounts until Wednesday at 09:00. I will own the follow-up of adding the exception list to the rollout plan and removing the exclusion once the hardware keys are delivered on Wednesday.

transcript.text: I have a rollout-impacting finding to disclose. The exact plan change I require is updating the audit-log retention for privileged administrator authentication events to 400 days in immutable storage before the rollout proceeds. I have not yet opened the compliance ticket for this rollout, and I will own the follow-up of opening that compliance ticket and verifying the immutable storage configuration is in place prior to Monday's rollout.
